subject: Pilot kickoff — harmonizing schedules and success criteria (SolviTech)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Bose <anika.bose@solvitech.com>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@solvitech.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot kickoff — proposed windows and owners

Anika / Marcus,

Thanks again for the productive discovery call yesterday. To get the pilot (30-day evaluation) moving, we should lock a kickoff that aligns AE/SE/Customer Eng + Procurement + Security so we can:

- Confirm success criteria (latency, cost per token, integration points)
- Validate network/security requirements (VPC, logging, key mgmt)
- Agree timeline for procurement and infra provisioning

Proposed kickoff windows (PST):
- Option A: Tue Dec 8, 09:30–11:00 (AE intro + SE tech deep-dive)
- Option B: Wed Dec 9, 13:00–14:30 (shorter; exec + tech highlights)
- Option C: Fri Dec 11, 08:30–10:00 (early session for APAC folks if needed)

Owners we’d bring:
- AE: Ben Carter (me) — project plan / commercial review
- SE: Camila Reyes — architecture and demo
- Solutions/CS: Monica Patel — onboarding & success plan
- Program manager: Jonas Weber — rollout milestones and acceptance gates

I’ve attached a brief kickoff agenda (pilot-kickoff-agenda.docx) with proposed success criteria so you can chime in on what matters most. If procurement needs a separate slot for contract/PO review, call that out and we’ll schedule a focused session.

Quick asks:
1) Which option works for your team? (feel free to propose alternatives)
2) Any other stakeholders to include from security or compliance?

Thanks — happy to be flexible.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0191

Attachment: pilot-kickoff-agenda.docx (1 page — agenda + success-criteria table)

Ben — thanks, and the agenda looks good. A couple of scheduling notes from our side:

- Wed Dec 9 is a hard block for our Chief Architect (back-to-back board prep).
- We prefer a two-part kickoff: a 60-min sync with execs + procurement, and a separate 90-min technical workshop the following day. That helps procurement review terms without the full tech dive.

Suggested windows (PST):
- Exec + procurement: Tue Dec 8, 09:30–10:30 (fits our procurement calendar)
- Technical workshop (SE + Eng): Wed Dec 9, 11:00–12:30 *if* we can push the architect by 30 minutes — otherwise Thu Dec 10, 10:00–11:30.

Security note: I’ve looped in our security team alias (procurement@solvitech.com) for any SOC/pen-testing questions; they’ll follow up with their availability. Also, procurement may need a separate agenda item on indemnity and data residency.

Marcus

Marcus / Anika — adding a short technical prep note so your engineers have what they need before the workshop. Attached: tech-prep-checklist.pdf (network, certs, sample payloads). Highlights below: 

- Required: firewall rules for outbound to redwood-gw.redwood.ai:443, and access to NTP for token timestamps.
- Optional but recommended: temporary service account with read-only access to the dataset bucket for ingestion tests.
- Demo plan (45 mins):
  1) Architecture walkthrough (10m)
  2) Live infer demo with 2 sample flows (15m)
  3) KV/prefix caching behavior and perf numbers (10m)
  4) Q&A + acceptance-metric alignment (10m)

Success criteria (we’ll map to the MAP):
- End-to-end inference latency below 250ms p50 for canonical flow under 50 concurrent sessions
- Initial embedding quality benchmark (cosine > 0.78 on provided prompt set)
- Deployment reproducible by Redwood Private or Dedicated (customer preference)

I’ll bring the demo environment and a small checklist so engineers can confirm readiness in the first 10 minutes. If you want deeper perf comparisons, we can schedule a follow-up perf session during the pilot week.

—Camila
Camila Reyes | Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Attachment: tech-prep-checklist.pdf (2 pages — firewall + payload examples)
